Evaluator-only independent fixture labels, generic templates, parameters and assumptions; opaque scenario IDs.

real_binding_gaps: No real SCADA/alarm point inventory, sensor cadence/latency or access authorization verified.
No authentic runbook/limits store or live CIM/CGMES topology bound.
No electrical simulation, live control, cloud/model call, LLM evaluation or operational safety/effectiveness claim.
resource_manifest.replay_boundary: Host must scope scenario_id and asset_ids; enforce window_start <= ts <= decision_time, available_at <= decision_time and quality=good. Knowledge requires valid_from and available_at <= decision_time. No authoring, variants, split labels, source reports or manifest paths in an agent view.
resource_manifest.report_derived_facts: Only page-cited records in authoring/source_events.json support report claims: identities/classes, primary event intervals, pre-trip 298/299 MW and 597 MW loss, no Murray generation/load loss, reported pre-existing outages, action timing and approximate 1370 to 910 MVA relation.

resources.description: SYNTHETIC asset identities, aliases, kinds, initial states and point units; no report labels.
SYNTHETIC case-scoped samples; filter event time, availability, scope and quality before use.
SYNTHETIC case-scoped alarm indications; no authoring references or later causes in messages.
SYNTHETIC pre-event fixture guidance plus strictly late forensic exclusion probes; not authentic procedures.
SYNTHETIC CIM100 RDF/XML illustrative subset with separate mock cooling dependencies; no CGMES conformity.

synthetic_assumptions.text: All mock asset/point IDs, UUID mRIDs, wiring, permits, detailed topology and unresolved nominal voltages are illustrative; aliases are a manually reviewed crosswalk, not an official estate map.

Fixed +10:00 follows both reports. All minute events use SIMULATED second 30 inside the source interval. Approximate rating actions use explicit +/-120-second uncertainty around the reported minute; the source provides no numerical bound. Unavailable isolation/work completion times remain null.

Cadence, bounded keyed noise, analog ramps, quality impairments, availability delays, alarm codes/messages and all unreported MW/MVA/voltage/vacuum/cooling values are fabricated. Last primary pre-trip MW anchors are exactly 298/299; Murray generation stays zero. Availability means ready/in service, not synchronized; standby Jeeralang units remain available before synchronization.

YWPS_U2 is assumed unavailable before every scenario; native diagram text alone does not resolve that state. Only one representative Murray generator is included, not every unit from both stations; source states all were already out of service.

No CGMES/profile conformity, power-flow validity or real topology reconstruction. Generator nominal 20 kV outside the report-backed Yallourn pair is invented. Aggregate asset breaker indicators are not individual CIM switch states. Cooling/vacuum signatures and exact recovery times are invented; mock suppliesCoolingTo is not an electrical edge.

Pre-dated runbooks, synchronous combination tables, action prerequisites, decision deadlines and escalation rules are fixture assumptions, not authentic AEMO procedures. A support recommendation is not an exact MW replacement. Actions are mock recommendations only, never switching, dispatch or EMS writes.

Only action tasks receive independently authored operator/event-service notifications from selected source event definitions. Availability at each cutoff is explicitly assumed, not report availability. Source intervals retain their precision; notifications prove neither recommendation prerequisites nor cause.

Regular sampling covers each short decision window plus a future tail. Correlated-state cases additionally contain sparse future historical timeline anchors, not continuous monitoring. Late-arrival probes and post-cutoff forensic documents test exclusion; source evidence, actual actions and labels are evaluator-only. Later knowledge availability is conservatively invented after all cutoffs.

Bad/missing/stale telemetry, delayed alarms and benign planned tests are independent fixture variations, not claims about historical sensor failures. Murray labels were authored independently of pipeline output; the holdout split is already exposed and no untouched-holdout claim is made.
